newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel airfreight profits up 8.4pc.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel airfreight profits up 8.4pc.

text.p: Kuehne & Nagel International AG said its airfreight division improved gross profits 8.4 percent to 215.5 million Swiss francs ($147 million) in 1996.
The airfreight division increased its net result after depreciation and taxes by 7.3 percent to 41.3 million Sfr, the annual company report said.
But its global air cargo turnover fell 2.3 percent to 1.187 billion Sfr, it added.
Kuehne & Nagel increased business on transpacific and South Atlantic routes but the situation in eastern Europe remained unsatisfactory, the report said.
The company won new customers in 1996, pressed ahead with bar-coding and launched its aircraft spares control and tracking system (Ascot).

The electrical and electronic industries remained the main customers and a global team was set up to provide customised solutions for multinational clients. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
